desc: grid is a rectangle of rows of equal length; "#" is a live cell and "." a dead one. Apply steps generations (steps >= 0) of Conway's Game of Life and return the grid. In each generation every cell counts its live neighbours among the 8 surrounding cells (cells beyond the edge of the grid count as dead and never come alive; the grid does not grow): a live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbours stays alive, a dead cell with exactly 3 becomes alive, and every other cell is dead in the next generation. All cells update at the same time.
